title: Improving code-mixed hate detection by native sample mixing: A case study for Hindi-English code-mixed scenario
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical methodology (native sample mixing) to improve the performance of multilingual language models in detecting hate speech within code-mixed text. While the datasets used include categories such as 'religious hatred', the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or specific ethical systems themselves; it treats them as classification labels for a detection task.
